query: SELECT TOP 30000 s.specObjID, s.ra, s.dec, s.z, s.zErr, s.subClass, p.petroMag_r FROM SpecObj AS s JOIN PhotoObj AS p ON s.bestObjID = p.objID WHERE s.class = 'GALAXY' AND s.zWarning = 0 AND s.z BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.12 AND (s.specObjID % 5) = 0
attribution: Funding for SDSS-V by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation et al.
units: deg, redshift, mag, comoving Mpc (Planck18 — derived)
frame: ICRS; cartesian comoving Mpc, observer at origin
